title: ÆTHER: First Love v5 (romantic duet sway)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

request.prompt: A brand-new, deeply romantic love theme written the way the great Tamil and Telugu film composers write a love duet BGM: the boy and the girl meet for the first time and fall in love. Romance first: tender, intimate, warm, close, dreamy and longing, like two people looking into each other's eyes; sweet and hopeful, G major, never sad, but also NOT a celebration, NOT a festival, NOT heroic, NOT a party. Instrumental, no lyrics. Sound palette (keep it): a breathy bamboo flute, a sparkling felt piano, a glitch-chopped veena pluck, a sweet solo violin with slides, soft wordless female and male hums, a twinkling music-box shimmer, glass bangles; warm, close and wide, soft lush strings, warm reverb. The love duet: the flute is HIM, the violin (and the female hum) is HER. A slow, singable, aching love melody in a raga like Kalyani or Mohanam with long held notes, gamakam slides and gentle bends; he asks a phrase, she answers it, their phrases get closer, and finally they play the melody together in sweet harmony. Rhythm: a soft, slow, swaying romantic 6/8 groove like a boat rocking, about 54 dotted-quarter beats per minute, that never stops after 12 s but stays gentle and close: a soft tabla and dholak triplet sway, a soft brushed kick, finger snaps, bangles on the eighths, a warm round bass that rocks with the sway. No big drums, no loud hits, no shouting chorus. Timeline: 0-6 s: the shimmer and the flute alone play a rising tender three-note call (root, major third, fifth, the last note held and bent upward): he sees her. 6-12 s: the violin answers softly, shy; a warm pad and the felt piano. 12-24 s: the gentle 6/8 sway begins and stays; the flute sings the love melody, the violin answers each phrase. 24-36 s: the female hum sings her answer, the male hum joins softly; soft strings swell under them. 36-48 s: the veena pluck and piano play a sweet little interlude while flute and violin weave around each other, closer and closer. 48-50 s: a tender pause on one held string chord while the sway keeps rocking softly. 50-64 s: the most romantic moment: flute and violin play the love melody together in harmony over lush strings, the hums float above, the hook lifted gently up a whole step. 64-72 s: the sway slows, the flute plays the three-note call once more, the violin answers with one last note, ending on a soft bell. Not a party, not celebration, not heroic, not epic, not a trailer, no big drums or loud hits, no festival energy, not sad, not ambient without rhythm, no EDM, no white-noise risers, no side-chain pumping.

brief.notes: Jithesh 29 Oct 18:25: all tracks have the wow factor, the last two (v4 sway) especially good, 'but these are not romantic; we're missing that romance'. Diagnosis: v2-v4 prompts asked for joy, a whole-step lift, a joyful chorus, full drive, so they came out as celebration. v5 = the v4 sway structure (nonstop 6/8 rhythm, which he liked) made slower, softer and intimate, with a flute (him) and violin/female hum (her) duet that ends in harmony. Prompt mode (music_v2).

story: The first time a boy sees a girl: tender, intimate first love, him and her in a melody duet.
